# tagents

> Go CLI for managing AI agent fleet across tmux sessions and SSH machines.

## Commands

- list: List all agent sessions
- machines: List SSH-config machines
- status: Fleet summary counts
- read: Read agent tmux pane output
- log: Read agent session log
- where: Get agent CWD
- send: Send message to agent
- broadcast: Send to all idle agents
- wait: Wait for agent to go idle
- inject: Send @file to agent
